drill: switch rollback and restoration on controlled runs
scope: fixture-controlled local drill plus CI-gated cohort truth; local sandbox cannot produce representative raco setup wall-clock timings (package compiles into user install dir, not checkout)

steps.name: global-switch-set-selects-full-path
steps.command: RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off evaluated by scripts/ci/prepared-env-report.rkt PREPARED_ENV boundary; covered by tests/test-ci-eager-compilation.rkt full-path cases
steps.expected: with switch set, prepared-artifact restore path is not taken; the action body takes the eager full path (purge, relink, raco setup --no-docs --jobs 4 --pkgs q fmt)
steps.observed: full-path selection asserted green: prepared-env reports full-path regime under RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off

steps.name: unsuccessful-mitigation-rolls-back-to-restore-path
steps.command: full-path failure branch in .github/actions/setup-racket/action.yml (raco setup or relink fails)
steps.expected: action exits non-zero without a per-file compile fallback and without advertising success; downstream restore-based delivery is not claimed as recovery
steps.observed: fixture asserts fallback forbidden and failure propagates as job failure

steps.name: restore-path-purges-untrusted-checkout-bytecode-before-use
steps.command: restore branch of setup-racket action on controlled run
steps.expected: stale checkout bytecode cannot execute: restore purges checkout *.zo/*.dep/compiled dirs before artifact relink
steps.observed: fixture asserts purge-on-restore (stale mtime, future mtime, and pre-existing compiled fixtures all purged)

steps.name: future-mtime-checkout-bytecode-cannot-execute
steps.command: seed checkout with zo files with mtime in the future, run restore-branch evaluation
steps.expected: purge removes them regardless of mtime; BUG-0065 invariant retained

steps.name: single-eager-boundary-per-job
steps.command: static assert on ci.yml via tests/test-ci-eager-compilation.rkt single-boundary case
steps.expected: at most one eager setup boundary per job; internal jobs=4 unchanged; runner/test membership unchanged
steps.observed: single-boundary fixture green; no per-file compile fallback in any job

switch-matrix.RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT=off: full eager path; all consumers honor the switch (7 audited consumers)
switch-matrix.RACKET_PREPARED_ARTIFACT unset or on: restore path with mandatory purge; identical runner membership and worker counts
switch-matrix.rollback rule: unsuccessful mitigation is rolled back to restore path; restore is never advertised as successful recovery

timing.local-sandbox: not representative: raco setup --pkgs q compiles into user install dir; checkout zo count stays 0; wall-clock numbers intentionally not recorded
timing.ci-cohort: owned by coordinator: >=3 comparable PR head SHAs, primary PR guard plus R1 p95 of slowest fast-shard runner; R1 pass is containment only, never a recovery claim
timing.residual-gap: pre-W4 233-292s job walls and runner/job boundary differences remain unaddressed by containment

anchor: 2171s figure is a single-PR max, not a population tail
